virality_data.topic: Designing an Agentic Harness: Optimizing Skill Execution and Context Memory for Autonomous Coding Workflows
virality_data.analysis: The current bottleneck in autonomous AI agents has shifted from base LLM reasoning to agent harnesses—managing skills, context bloat, and instinct memory without burning 100k tokens per task. The breakout traction of repositories like affaan-m/ECC and obra/superpowers proves developers are desperate for structured agent harness architectures. This tutorial breaks down how to build a modular, low-token agent harness in Python that caches instinctual instructions and exposes deterministic local tool calls.
